rules.accounting: Refill water credit when nonpositive; add credit rather than reset. Generated RF debits both independent fuel and water credits. Persist both credits and tank contents; batch count is not a per-tick water rate.

rules.scope: Static registration/lookup rule, prior to inter-mod changes
rules.lookup: Reject empty stacks and container items. Positive explicit fuel-map entry takes precedence. Otherwise furnace burn ticks * 10, accepted only at >=3000 RF. Coal JSON overrides default; charcoal uses parser default.

rules.scope: Basic unaugmented furnace/pulverizer with SmallStorage=false and configured P=20
rules.rate: E>=18000:20; E<2000:min(2,E); otherwise floor(E/900). Final-operation and scheduler ordering need separate parity checks.

rules.scope: Basic unaugmented steam dynamo with SmallStorage=false and configured P=40
rules.rate: E<=4000:40; E>36000:4; otherwise floor((40000-E)/900). Generation and accepted transfer are separate; verify saturation behavior before implementation.

rules.scope: Default scan of registered furnace recipes; non-food dust input to ingot output; absent an earlier recipe
rules.registry_condition: An actual dust-to-ingot smelting registration must exist. Stack counts come from that registration. This is a cost-rule template, not a resolved iron recipe.

rules.scope: No augments/enchantments; default scaling selected by pack configs
rules.notes: Tier names, augment validity, upgrade crafting and in-world transitions still require mapping; these arrays alone do not implement upgrades.
